name: Qwen 3.6 Plus
short: Alibaba's Qwen3.6 Plus MoE (397B-A17B, 1M context) for real-world agents and coding; SWE-bench Pro 56.6%, LiveCodeBench 87.1%, now superseded.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: Alibaba’s earlier real-world agent MoE — the generation that established the Plus tier for practical GUI/API agent work.
tradeoff: Explicitly superseded by the 3.7/3.8 generations; new agent work belongs on the newer Plus tiers.
